task: Find the package "requests", and tell me its latest version number and its license.
summary: I searched PyPI for "requests" with the labelled search field, which worked well: the home page has clear landmarks, a skip link and named controls. The search then triggered a bot check (a CAPTCHA image with an audio alternative). I did not try to solve it, so I could not reach the package page; this is not an accessibility verdict. The bot check itself is mostly accessible: it has an audio CAPTCHA, but its field label only mentions the image.

steps.reason: In the "search" landmark there is textbox "Search PyPI"; I type the package name.

issues.title: Bot check instructions only mention the image
issues.description: After searching, PyPI showed a "Client Challenge" bot check. It does offer an accessible alternative (button "Play audio CAPTCHA" and a download link), which is good. But the answer field is named "Enter the characters seen in the image below", so a screen reader user lands in a field that asks about an image they cannot see, and has to discover the audio option above it on their own.
issues.fix: Name the field for both options, e.g. <label for="answer">Enter the characters from the image or the audio challenge</label>, and place the audio button right before the field.
